title: sorbus aria proles latifolia
intro: Sorbus aria proles latifolia, commonly known as the Whitebeam, is a deciduous tree species native to the UK and Western Europe, characterized by its broad, rounded leaves and clusters of small white flowers. The health benefits of Whitebeam include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Whitebeam are attributed to its ability to support digestive health, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote a sense of calmness. The bioactive constituents of Whitebeam include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
